source: Project empirical state-conditioned re-exposure in acquisition domain, not official camera software or dark-frame sensor calibration
physics: raw Photon-Poisson + empirical Gaussian effective noise + bias, quantized to digitizer. Optics: patterned emitter proxy, measured BioSR OTF, 2x2 bin integration. Source optical phase/angle from rDL-SIM fit; no normalization between states.
units: camera ADU excess over mean bias; shot means in photons using authors average count conversion
limit: Haar proxy may include unresolved structure, fixed pattern, shot scale error and camera correlation. L05 same-image spatial check, not independent validation. Noise transfer uses Cell002 withheld from intercept fitting. Background fitted to broad spatial scales in raw domain; not a pure reconstruction from the network alone.
